Bluesky has no signed webhook delivery. Events arrive over WebSocket streams you subscribe to: the relay firehose (com.atproto.sync.subscribeRepos) or Jetstream. See https://bsky.network/docs/consuming-the-firehose.
One MP4 per post from a media.upload reference. Publishing reads the video job once and creates the post only when the processed blob is ready; it never waits or polls.
Native hideReply adds or removes a reply URI in the root post's threadgate hiddenReplies list. Only the root post's author can hide replies.
Uploads one video/mp4 Blob of at most 300,000,000 bytes to the Bluesky video service with a PDS service token. Returns the processing job ID as the media reference.
native.uploadVideo sends one app.bsky.video.uploadVideo request and returns the job.
native.getVideoJobStatus reads app.bsky.video.getJobStatus once per call.
native.getVideoUploadLimits reads the daily video allowance. Uploads do not check it automatically.

Bluesky treats posts as immutable. A putRecord rewrite succeeds on the PDS, but the Bluesky AppView ignores post updates and the new CID breaks existing strong references from replies, quotes, likes, and reposts.
Verifies X-Twitter-Webhooks-Signature-OAuth2 or the legacy X-Twitter-Webhooks-Signature and decodes Account Activity deliveries. Answer the CRC GET with answerXWebhookChallenge.

User-context OAuth2 token; current X API access/billing required. Up to four static JPEG/PNG image Blobs, each at most 5 MiB, or one MP4 video up to 512 MiB / one GIF up to 15 MiB via 1 MiB chunked upload with bounded processing poll. Post attach can still reject over-duration video with 403.

Text-only edit through native.updatePost. X requires X Premium, the account's own post, and a recent post within X's edit window and edit count. Polls, replies to others, reposts, and scheduled posts are not editable. Each edit creates a new post ID.
The required read scope depends on the requested relationship kind.
Follow writes require an eligible paid X API tier.
Follow writes require an eligible paid X API tier.
Enterprise plan only.
Enterprise plan only.

Replies come from recent search with conversation_id, so only replies from the last 7 days are returned. Pass the conversation's root post. Page limits are 10-100. Recent search allows 450 requests per 15 minutes per app and 300 per user, and X bills post reads under the app's plan.
Recent search covers the last 7 days. Full-archive search requires an eligible X API pay-per-use or Enterprise plan.
MP4 Blob chunked INIT/APPEND/FINALIZE with 1 MiB segments and bounded STATUS poll honoring check_after_secs.
GIF Blob chunked upload; large GIFs process asynchronously before attach.
Requires a user-context token and an X API tier that includes Direct Messages.
X API v2 has no notifications list endpoint. Use mentions.read, or the Account Activity or X Activity API webhooks and streams.
Requires a user-context token and an X API tier that includes Direct Messages.
Native hideReply hides or unhides replies in conversations the authenticated user started. Requires a user-context token.
Filtered stream rules and streaming transport are not implemented by this adapter.
Verifies Meta X-Hub-Signature-256 with the app secret and decodes replies, mentions, publish, and delete deliveries. Answer the GET handshake with answerMetaWebhookChallenge.
Hiding replies and pending-reply moderation require Threads reply-management permissions.
Deletes only replies published by the authenticated user. Threads allows 100 deletions per account per day. Use hideReply for other users' replies.
The Threads API has no endpoint to edit a published post; text and attachments are set when the container is created.
The profile endpoint reads the authorized app-scoped user; profile lookup requires threads_profile_discovery.
Without threads_keyword_search approval, results are limited to the authorized user's posts.
Threads does not expose messaging APIs to standard apps.
The Threads API has no notifications endpoint. Use mentions.read, reply reads, or webhooks instead.
Verifies the PubSubHubbub X-Hub-Signature for subscriptions created with hub.secret and decodes the Atom feed. Answer the GET verification with answerYouTubeWebhookChallenge.
Unaudited projects may be restricted to private visibility. Upload completion and video processing are separate.
Scheduled videos are uploaded private with a future ISO publishAt timestamp.
The YouTube Data API has no notifications resource. activities.list reports actions a channel took, not notifications it received.
Uses search.list with type=video. Each request costs 100 quota units.
comments.delete costs 50 quota units. Delete a thread through its top-level comment ID. Google does not document which comments a channel may delete; insufficient permissions return 403 forbidden.
Reports require an explicit bounded date range and provider-supported metrics.
The channel must have live streaming enabled in YouTube Studio. Use native access: liveBroadcasts.
Verifies TikTok-Signature (HMAC-SHA256 over timestamp and raw body) with the client secret and a 300 second default timestamp window, then decodes the event.
Verified URL source; explicit creator choices/consent. Public posting requires app audit. Draft mode uses video.upload.
The Content Posting API sets caption and privacy only when a post is initialized. It has no endpoint to edit a published post.
Standard Content Posting and Display APIs do not expose comments.
TikTok for Developers APIs do not expose a user notification inbox.
Professional accounts, public HTTPS media, explicit native continuation for processing containers. Carousels must have matching aspect ratios to avoid upstream cropping.
Instagram Graph API does not provide an edit endpoint for published media.
Hide or unhide a comment, or enable or disable comments on media. Instagram Login and Facebook Login are supported where the account and app permissions qualify.
Meta documents media deletion for Instagram API with Facebook Login only. See https://developers.facebook.com/docs/instagram-platform/reference/instagram-media
Meta documents media deletion for Instagram API with Facebook Login only. See https://developers.facebook.com/docs/instagram-platform/reference/instagram-media
Verifies Meta X-Hub-Signature-256 with the app secret and decodes object=instagram deliveries. Answer the GET handshake with answerMetaWebhookChallenge.
The Instagram API has no notifications edge. Use mentions.read, tags, comments, or webhooks instead.
Explicit author URN and public visibility. Organization role and app product approval required. Registered images must be AVAILABLE before creating a post.
Member read access is restricted. Publication permission does not grant read permission.
Returns the configured member only. Reads the OpenID Connect userinfo endpoint and checks that sub matches the author URN. Requires the Sign In with LinkedIn using OpenID Connect product.
Native deleteComment needs the post URN and the complete commentUrn. LinkedIn does not document which comments an actor may delete; expect only the configured author's own comments to succeed.
Requires the Community Management API product and organization administrator access. Member accounts are not eligible.

LinkedIn enables webhooks only for apps with an approved webhook use case. Organization social action notifications also need the Community Management API and an organization administrator. Verifies X-LI-Signature (HMAC-SHA256 over hmacsha256= plus the raw body) with the app client secret; answer the GET validation with answerLinkedInWebhookChallenge.

Organization social-action notifications from the last 60 days, pulled with offset paging. Requires the Community Management API product and organization administrator access. LinkedIn has no member notification API.
LinkedIn does not expose a seen or read state for notifications.
Organization total followers only; authenticated member must administer the organization. No member-profile analytics claimed.
Community Management API product and organization administrator access are required. Member accounts are not eligible.
Community Management API product and organization administrator access are required. Member accounts are not eligible.
Community Management API product and organization administrator access are required. Member accounts are not eligible.
Author-feed pagination uses the returned offset cursor.
Community Management product permissions and author post read access required. Analytics contains returned social-action counts only.
Community Management product permissions and author post read access required. Analytics contains returned social-action counts only.
Community Management product permissions and author post read access required. Analytics contains returned social-action counts only.
